entries.en: The report blamed negligence for the loss of the records.
entries.zh: 报告将档案丢失归咎于疏忽。

entries.en: The novel exposes the exploitation of workers in a remote factory.
entries.zh: 小说揭露了偏远工厂中对工人的剥削。

entries.en: He changed into shorts before joining the beach game.
entries.zh: 参加海滩游戏前，他换上了短裤。

entries.en: She gained managerial experience by running the small theatre.
entries.zh: 经营这家小剧院让她积累了管理经验。

entries.en: The school granted her an exemption from the introductory class.
entries.zh: 学校准许她免修入门课。

entries.en: The tiny kitchen uses every corner economically.
entries.zh: 这个小厨房节省地利用着每个角落。

entries.en: The model represents the molecular structure with coloured spheres.
entries.zh: 模型用彩球表示分子结构。

entries.en: The narrator reveals the secret only on the final page.
entries.zh: 叙述者直到最后一页才揭开秘密。

entries.en: The old entrance was permanently closed after the extension opened.
entries.zh: 扩建部分开放后，旧入口永久关闭了。

entries.en: The museum's website includes photographs of its newest acquisitions.
entries.zh: 博物馆网站上有最新入藏藏品的照片。

entries.en: She remained skeptical until the inventor demonstrated the machine.
entries.zh: 直到发明者演示机器，她才不再怀疑。

entries.en: We received confirmation of our booking just before lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭前，我们收到了预订确认。

entries.en: The north-facing room stays comparatively cool in summer.
entries.zh: 朝北的房间夏天相对凉爽。

entries.en: A biologist identified the tiny creatures in the pond water.
entries.zh: 一位生物学家辨认了池水里的微小生物。

entries.en: The walk highlights architectural details above the shop windows.
entries.zh: 这条步行路线重点介绍商店橱窗上方的建筑细节。

entries.en: The organizer found extra chairs for the unexpected visitors.
entries.zh: 组织者为意外到访的客人找来了更多椅子。

entries.en: The detective identifies the murderer in the final chapter.
entries.zh: 侦探在最后一章认出了凶手。

entries.en: The surveyor marked the corners of the proposed building.
entries.zh: 测量员标出了拟建建筑的四角。

entries.en: The pier's reconstruction preserved much of its original design.
entries.zh: 码头重建保留了许多原始设计。

entries.en: The exhibition features predominantly black-and-white photographs.
entries.zh: 展览主要展出黑白照片。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows each kidney beside the spine.
entries.zh: 解剖模型展示了脊柱两侧的肾脏。

entries.en: The diary records the slow healing of his injured hand.
entries.zh: 日记记录了他受伤的手缓慢愈合的过程。

entries.en: The history lesson examined campaigns for the abolition of slavery.
entries.zh: 历史课研究了争取废除奴隶制的运动。

entries.en: The emergence of new shoots delighted the young gardeners.
entries.zh: 新芽的出现让年轻园丁们很开心。

entries.en: Her essay offers a synthesis of several competing explanations.
entries.zh: 她的文章综合了几种相互竞争的解释。

entries.en: The documentary follows years of litigation over the disputed painting.
entries.zh: 纪录片追踪了围绕争议画作持续多年的诉讼。

entries.en: The researchers questioned whether the apparent relationship was causal.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑表面上的关系是否属于因果关系。

entries.en: The fund supports the preservation of old coastal buildings.
entries.zh: 该基金支持保护保存沿海的老建筑。

entries.en: The model demonstrates the Earth's rotation with a small globe.
entries.zh: 模型用一个小地球仪演示了地球自转。
